header.title: Recoil Report, our Aug 14 catch-up
header.sub: The catch-up serialized into one map: where the conviction gradient rose at the product-bridge peak, where it settled through the process pushback, and the honest not-now at the end. Internal read, run on my own performance.

fields.label: Predicted (pre-call)
fields.value: Warm reconnect; the Invisible thesis resonates; a Google-style 'someday a team could use this' hedge; entry via 'invisible, one layer up.'

fields.label: Actual
fields.value: Thesis landed hard and in his own words; but the door was multiplayer + composability, the real objection was adoption process, and the close was an explicit not-now with a referral offer.

fields.label: Fork hit
fields.value: DEGRADED to referral-hold. Engaged, not bought. High-trust, low-urgency.

blocks.intro: Six load-bearing beliefs, tracked across the six segments of the call (reconnect, the ARCS explainer, the product-bridge peak, the process pushback, his Ascendancy build, the close). This is my own confidence gradient over the conversation, not his.
blocks.close: The signature of a warm not-now: the thesis line (gold) climbs and holds, the near-buyer line (red) peaks at the product-bridge moment then collapses through the process objection to a terminal low, while the orthogonal-echo and referral lines rise as he talks about his own build. No dramatic betrayal, a calm single-peak arc that resolves into a high-trust hold.

blocks.intro: Walk the critical path backward, each node gated by his actual objection. The bottleneck is the earliest node in my court.

blocks.note: Earliest in-my-court node is the adoption objection. It is already answered on the codex offer (the ex-ante receipt imports as JSON, no process to adopt). The next in-my-court node is the generalized referral artifact.

rows: an evidence-graded lattice: a node is load-bearing when enough uncorrelated sources connect to it
the same before/after read, pointed at relationships instead of decisions
DEWY receipts: self-contained context windows that stay interoperable across meetings
the geometric manifold: individual, dyad, and triad field-states, lossiness narrowed vertically and horizontally
a hypothesis as a core platform primitive
the ex-ante receipt: a bet filed before, scored against reality after

p: This was a reconnect, not a deal call, and the read reflects that. The highest-information event was the flip on B4: I under-weighted adoption and he named process friction as his first objection, which is more useful than the thesis landing.

Do not push a purchase. The move is to hold the trust, answer the process objection (done, on the codex), and stage the generalized referral artifact so that when he shifts from introverted to extroverted mode he has something to hand a founder with the gap. Next surface is his call, not mine: keep it at recoil, do not over-build a receipt-and-diamond family for a referral-hold.
